description: This file contains utility functions for loading, saving, and processing data in Spark's MLlib, including functions for parsing LIBSVM format, converting vectors, and generating linear data. It also defines classes for saving/loading models and generating test data.

classes.name: MLUtils
classes.description: Helper methods for data loading, saving, and conversion in MLlib.

classes.name: Saveable
classes.description: Mixin class for models and transformers that can be saved to disk.

classes.name: JavaSaveable
classes.description: Mixin for models that provide save() via Scala implementation.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: Mixin for classes that can load saved models from files.

classes.name: JavaLoader
classes.description: Mixin for classes that load models using Scala implementation.

classes.name: LinearDataGenerator
classes.description: Utilities for generating linear regression data.

methods.name: _parse_libsvm_line
methods.description: Parses a LIBSVM format line into label, indices, and values.

methods.name: _convert_labeled_point_to_libsvm
methods.description: Converts a LabeledPoint to LIBSVM string format.

methods.name: loadLibSVMFile
methods.description: Loads LIBSVM formatted data into an RDD of LabeledPoint.

methods.name: saveAsLibSVMFile
methods.description: Saves an RDD of LabeledPoint in LIBSVM format.

methods.name: loadLabeledPoints
methods.description: Loads labeled points saved as text files.

methods.name: appendBias
methods.description: Appends a bias term to a vector.

methods.name: loadVectors
methods.description: Loads vectors saved as text files.

methods.name: convertVectorColumnsToML
methods.description: Converts old vector columns to new MLlib vector type.

methods.name: convertVectorColumnsFromML
methods.description: Converts new MLlib vector columns to old vector type.

methods.name: convertMatrixColumnsToML
methods.description: Converts old matrix columns to new MLlib matrix type.

methods.name: convertMatrixColumnsFromML
methods.description: Converts new MLlib matrix columns to old matrix type.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a model or transformer to disk.

methods.name: _java_loader_class
methods.description: Returns the full class name of the Java loader.

methods.name: _load_java
methods.description: Loads a Java model from disk.

methods.name: generateLinearRDD
methods.description: Generates an RDD of linear regression data.
